Many people mean to read the Bible and never get started. The good news is that you do not need an hour a day. A few unhurried minutes, repeated, will take you further than you expect.

## It gives reliable guidance

::: scripture
“All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness.”

[2 Timothy 3:16]{.ref}
:::

Notice the word **profitable***. The Bible is meant to be used, not just admired.*

## How to begin

Pick one book and read a short section each day. Write down one thing that stood out.

::: cta
Start with one chapter today.
:::
